item.text:
Implemented in `/output` as ESM `.mjs` files.

Library hierarchy:
- [programName.mjs](/output/lib/cli/programName.mjs)
- [parseArguments.mjs](/output/lib/cli/parseArguments.mjs)
- [text.mjs](/output/lib/runtime/text.mjs)
- [runExecutable.mjs](/output/lib/yaml/runExecutable.mjs)

Entry file:
- [test20.mjs](/output/test20.mjs)

The Node version manually parses `process.argv`, preserves the `--a` required-argument behavior, and keeps YAML load/dump output aligned by delegating the transformation step to the provided `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable`. I verified parity for the sample-style cases, `--help`, missing `--a`, repeated `--a`, unknown arguments, negative values, a valid fallback-shaped input like `--a '- foo'`, and invalid YAML. The only unstable difference on YAML exceptions is the PyInstaller footer’s numeric `[PYI-…]` tag, which varies per process.
